crews.Name: Player
crews.Notes: You. Hall owner. Optional on the street.

crews.Name: Rico
crews.Notes: Runs the corners. Push-the-alley bonus. Betrayal if loyalty collapses.

crews.Name: Marcus
crews.Notes: Does not deploy on v0 defense. Runs the debrief.

territories.Name: Hall
territories.Blurb: Brick civic hall. Your table. Control never drops below 70.

territories.Name: NeonRow
territories.Blurb: Wet commercial street. Contested tonight. v0 defense.

territories.Name: MarketStrip
territories.Blurb: Canvas stalls. Locked until the v0 loop is closed.

territories.Name: Docks
territories.Blurb: River, cranes, warehouse doors. v0 territory after Neon Row.

quests.Name: DefendNeonRow
quests.Title: Hold Neon Row
quests.Summary: Two crews on the east mouths. Assign bodies. Pick a tactic. Hold the street.

quests.Name: DebriefMarcus
quests.Title: Debrief with Marcus
quests.Summary: Marcus wants names and a decision on the cameras. Loyalty moves here.

quests.Name: TakeoverDocks
quests.Title: Take the Docks
quests.Summary: Warehouse door is ajar. After the Row is resolved, push the river.

quests.Name: DebriefDocks
quests.Title: Debrief the river
quests.Summary: Marcus wants the warehouse names and a decision on the river cameras.

quests.Name: BetrayalVex
quests.Title: Vex sells the route
quests.Summary: Press Vex in the Hall while she is thin. Call her when armed. A tick can bring a buyer.

quests.Name: BetrayalRico
quests.Title: Rico walks
quests.Summary: Press Rico after an ego debrief. Call the corners when armed. A tick can bring a buyer.

quests.Name: ReclaimMarket
quests.Title: Reclaim Market Strip
quests.Summary: Post-v0. Stalls pay if you can hold them.

quests.Name: ReclaimOldWard
quests.Title: Reclaim Old Ward
quests.Summary: Post-v0. Ruin work. Hard fight, thin income.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Brief_01
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: Neon Row is leaking. Two crews on the east mouths, cameras still live. Marcus wants a debrief after — he always does. Who do you put on the street?
dialogue.ChoiceB_Text: Rico and Ray. Hold the corners.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Brief_Pick
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: Your table. Keep it to three. Marcus stays in the Hall — he is the debrief, not the street.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Brief_Ray
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: Ray already knows the corners. I'll walk with him. You can still swap bodies on the roster.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Brief_Lena
dialogue.Speaker: Lena
dialogue.Text: The alley cameras dump to a clerk on Market. If we cut the lights we lose claim but we lose heat. If we leave them, Marcus will smell it.
dialogue.ChoiceA_Text: Lena walks. Cut the lights if it comes to it.
dialogue.ChoiceB_Text: Keep Lena off the street. I'll pick.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Win_01
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: You held the Row. The corners are ours until morning. I don't want the story you tell the Hall. I want names. Who called the shots on the ground?
dialogue.ChoiceC_Text: I called it from the Hall.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Win_Rico
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: Rico can carry a street. Cameras still have us. Burn the footage, pay the clerk, or leave them and hope.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Win_Crew
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: Shared credit keeps them. Cameras still have us. Burn, pay, or leave them.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Win_Ego
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: They noticed. Loyalty thins when the Hall takes the name. Cameras still have us.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Win_End
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: That's the debrief. Watch the meters. The warehouse door is open if Neon isn't on fire.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Loss_01
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: We lost the Row. Heat is going to crawl toward the Hall. I still need names. Who do we put on the next walk, and what do we do about the cameras?
dialogue.ChoiceA_Text: Rico owns the miss. He'll fix it.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Loss_Rico
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: Rico will remember that. Cameras still have the miss. Burn, pay, or leave them.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Loss_Crew
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: Shared blame is cheaper than a scapegoat. Cameras still have the miss.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Loss_Ego
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: Owning it from the Hall is rare. They'll give you one more night. Cameras still have the miss.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Loss_End
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: That's the debrief. The Row is thin. Let the night run and watch control leak — or go take it back.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Docks_01
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: Warehouse door on the river is ajar. Two bodies minimum. Vex knows that door. Neon has to stay under a burn or we can't leave the Row.
dialogue.ChoiceB_Text: Vex and Rico. It's her door.
dialogue.ChoiceC_Text: Ask Lena about the warehouse cameras.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Docks_Pick
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: Two on the river, three if you can spare them. Marcus stays in the Hall.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Docks_Vex
dialogue.Speaker: Vex
dialogue.Text: I grew up on that crane line. You put me on the door I won't sell it tonight.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Docks_Lena
dialogue.Speaker: Lena
dialogue.Text: Warehouse cameras dump to a clerk on the river, not Market. Cut the lights and the takeover heat dies. Leave them and the river stays loud.
dialogue.ChoiceA_Text: Lena walks. Cut the lights if it comes to it.
dialogue.ChoiceB_Text: Keep Lena off the river. I'll pick.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Docks_Win_01
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: You took the warehouse. Takeover is noisy even when it holds. I want names. Who opened the door?
dialogue.ChoiceC_Text: I called it from the Hall.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Docks_Win_Vex
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: Her door, her name. Warehouse cameras still have us. Burn, pay the dock clerk, or leave the river cameras.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Docks_Win_Crew
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: Shared credit keeps them. Warehouse cameras still have the walk.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Docks_Win_Ego
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: They noticed. Loyalty thins when the Hall takes a river. Cameras still have us.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Docks_Win_End
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: That's the river. Docks will leak if you never put bodies on it. Tick, or walk Neon if it's slipping.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Docks_Loss_01
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: The warehouse stayed shut. Heat on the river. I still need names.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Docks_Loss_Vex
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: She's already thin. Warehouse cameras still have the miss.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Docks_Loss_Crew
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: Shared blame is cheaper than a scapegoat. River cameras still have the miss.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Docks_Loss_Ego
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: Owning a river miss from the Hall is rare. They'll give you one more night.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Docks_Loss_End
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: That's the debrief. The warehouse stayed shut. Tick or send them back.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Market_01
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: Stalls on the Strip will pay if we reclaim them. Not v0. Don't open this until the Row loop is boring.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Ward_01
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: Old Ward is masonry and empty lots. Reclamation work. Not v0.

dialogue.Name: Event_Vex_Press_01
dialogue.Speaker: Vex
dialogue.Text: I'm not at the table. I'm at the door. Buy me or I start looking at buyers.
dialogue.ChoiceA_Text: Sit. Your name on the river.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Vex_Held
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: The river door is seated. Put her name on the next walk or this was rent.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Vex_Lean
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: She's closer to a buyer. Next tick can bring one. Call her before the night does.

dialogue.Name: Event_Vex_01
dialogue.Speaker: Vex
dialogue.Text: I have a buyer for the river. Last number. Buy me, cut me, or I walk it tonight.

dialogue.Name: Event_Vex_Cut
dialogue.Speaker: Vex
dialogue.Text: I sold it because you kept me thin. Keep the warehouse. I'm gone.

dialogue.Name: Event_Vex_Sale
dialogue.Speaker: Vex
dialogue.Text: Clerk already has the route. You can burn cameras. You can't unsell it.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Vex_Gone
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: The river door is empty. Names still at the table need a line.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Vex_End
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: That's the door. Tick, walk Neon, or take the river without her.

dialogue.Name: Rico_Table_01
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: You put your name on the hold. The corners heard it from the Hall, not from me. Buy them back or they're yours.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Rico_Word
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: He heard it twice. He's thin. Press the corners before a night does.

dialogue.Name: Event_Rico_Press_01
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: You keep putting your name on the hold. Mine's getting thin. Buy the corners or I walk.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Rico_Held
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: The corners are seated. Don't ego him twice in a row.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Rico_Lean
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: He's closer to walking. Call the corners before a tick does.

dialogue.Name: Event_Rico_01
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: Hall keys. A buyer. Last number. Buy me, cut me, or I leave the note.

dialogue.Name: Event_Rico_Cut
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: You wanted the name on the door. Keep it. I'm off the board.

dialogue.Name: Event_Rico_Sale
dialogue.Speaker: Rico
dialogue.Text: Keys are already gone. The corners will leak without me.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Rico_Gone
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: The corners are empty. Ray can hold a mouth. He can't hold two.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Rico_End
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: That's the corners. The Hall still stands. Watch the leak.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Morning_01
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: Morning. The take is on the books. Bank it, pay who stayed, or burn leftover footage.

dialogue.Name: Marcus_Morning_End
dialogue.Speaker: Marcus
dialogue.Text: That's the books. Walk Neon, take the river, or let the night run again.

tactics.label: Hold the corners
tactics.blurb: Ray's work. Slow, ugly, holds ground.

tactics.label: Push the alley
tactics.blurb: Rico walks it loud. You keep the street and you keep the noise.

tactics.label: Cut the lights
tactics.blurb: Cameras go dark. Less claim, less heat.
